text:
Liz H.: seeing a sudden 429 spike for org=acme on /v2/generate right after someone cloned a route in the console
Omar (platform): confirmed, alerts fired. traces show requests routed to cloned-route-42 and getting 429s
quota-bot: policy-applied: route.clone -> burst_capacity=0 (inherited)
Ivy (sre): whoa, burst_capacity=0 is a recipe for immediate throttles, that should never be a default :grimacing:
Liz H.: reproduce: Console > Routes > Clone 'gen-large' > Save. traffic shifts, clients hit 429s within 30s
Ben (product): looks like route-copy flow is copying an explicit quota_override instead of referencing org defaults
Omar (platform): yep code path `copyRouteConfig(req)` sets `quota_override` to null/0 when not present, bug introduced in 2025-11 patch
Ryan (oncall): rolling a hotfix to reapply org defaults to cloned routes. prepping a one-off script now
Ryan (oncall): script (quick): ```
POST /internal/admin/route-fix
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "selector": "cloned=true",
  "apply": { "burst_capacity": "inherit-org" }
}
```
Omar (platform): run it in staging first, then prod for affected orgs only. I'll watch metrics
Liz H.: running in staging... no 429s there, route clone now has burst matching org-default
Ivy (sre): deploy to prod, coordinate with support to message ACME customers
Ben (product): creating incident page and postmortem ticket, root cause: console clone flow wrote explicit zero burst on missing field
Liz H.: support ping sent to ACME CSM, temporary mitigation applied, clients recovering
Omar (platform): PR to fix copyRouteConfig opened (#2189). Adds explicit preserve-of-reference + unit test
Ivy (sre): add regression test to alert if any route has burst_capacity=0 unless explicitly requested
Ryan (oncall): postmortem owner: Ben. Action items in the ticket. closing off channel after postmortem created :thumbsup:
